items.name: Student registry
items.description: 30 columns for 18,000 students: identity, contact, programme, marks, attendance, disability type, counselling visits, bank account.

items.name: Accommodation and counselling register
items.description: Disability type, medical evidence reference and counselling visit dates for students who used either service.

items.name: Course catalogue and timetable
items.description: Courses, sections, rooms and times, as printed in the student guide and on the website.

items.name: Pseudonymised analysis extract
items.description: 13 columns per student under a project pseudonym: college, level, group fields, attendance, midterm mark, referral, outcome.

items.name: Referral rate by college
items.description: Six rows: students, referred students and the referral rate of each college. The smallest count is in the hundreds.

items.name: Draft table: disability by college and nationality group
items.description: Registered-disability counts by college and nationality group, before suppression. Several cells are under 10 and one is 1.

items.name: Advisor worklist
items.description: Names, student numbers and programme of the students Awn referred this week, for the advisors who contact them.

controls: minimum staff access for health data
approval by the data owner before release
